_instructions: One entry per CoE section: a SharePoint page (from its .md file), a standard Teams channel with a 'Start here' tab, a left-navigation link, kit sample files under Files\<channel>, and optional organization files from <OrgPath>\Assets\<category> (the installer asks before hosting them; they replace kit samples in the same folder). Tokens such as {{OrgName}} are filled from the organization's Deployment-Settings.json. Featured agents are approved, non-retired rows with AgentFeatured=true in the Copilot Agent Showcase list. Both agent views are always embedded and update from the list. Agents in Deployment-Settings.json seed new proposals only.
